description: This file contains unit tests for the GrainInterfacePropertyDiagnosticAnalyzer, which enforces rules about properties in Orleans grain interfaces. It verifies that properties are disallowed in grain interfaces, addressable interfaces, and grain observers, and that static properties are permitted. The tests use Xunit framework and include various scenarios to ensure the analyzer behaves correctly.

classes.name: GrainInterfacePropertyDiagnosticAnalyzerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the GrainInterfacePropertyDiagnosticAnalyzer, testing various scenarios of property usage in grain-related interfaces.

methods.name: GrainInterfacePropertyNoError
methods.description: Tests that interfaces with only methods pass without diagnostics.

methods.name: NoPropertiesAllowedInGrainInterface
methods.description: Tests that properties in IGrain interfaces are correctly flagged as diagnostics.

methods.name: NoPropertiesAllowedInIAddressableInterface
methods.description: Tests that properties in IAddressable interfaces are flagged.

methods.name: NoPropertiesAllowedInIGrainObserverInterface
methods.description: Tests that properties in IGrainObserver interfaces are flagged.

methods.name: StaticInterfacePropertiesAllowedInGrainInterface
methods.description: Verifies static properties are allowed in grain interfaces.

methods.description: Verifies static properties are allowed in addressable interfaces.
